app.title: From Mud to Crown
menu.title: Menu
menu.confirmNew: Your current game will be lost if you haven't saved it. Start over?
menu.howTo: Tap a plot to sow and tap it again to harvest once it's ripe. Tap the coop or the pen to collect eggs and milk, and sell at the market. As you level up you can clear the grass next to the field, sow other crops and buy livestock.
menu.saveHintFile: Your game is saved to a file on your device. Once you pick it, it saves itself every few in-game days.
menu.saveHintDownload: Your game downloads as a .json file. To keep playing, load it from this menu.
market.title: Village market
market.subtitle: Prices change every week and with the season
msg.notEnoughCoins: You need {cost} coins for the seed
save.error.format: That file isn't a From Mud to Crown save
save.error.newer: That save comes from a newer version of the game
msg.dormant: Out of season ({crop}): it won't grow until the season changes

msg.landLimit: Your level allows no more than {max} plots
msg.animalLocked: You can't buy that animal yet
msg.bought.chicken: A new hen in the coop
msg.bought.cow: A new cow in the pen
msg.workerLeft: Your farmhand has left: there was nothing to pay him with
msg.optionUnavailable: You can't choose that right now
msg.season.winter: Winter arrives: wheat and carrots won't grow until spring
plant.title: What will you sow?
land.title: Clear a plot
land.text: Clearing and ploughing this land costs {cost} coins. Each new plot costs more than the last.
levelup.title: Level {level}
levelup.unlock.buyLand: You can clear the grass next to the field
levelup.unlock.buyChicken: You can buy hens at the market
levelup.unlock.buyCow: You can buy cows at the market
event.levy.title: The lord's levy
event.levy.text: A herald of the baron brings ill news: there is war on the border. Every farm must give grain for the troops or, failing that, silver.
event.levy.result.give: The herald writes your name among the loyal. The baron does not forget those who serve him.
event.levy.result.pay: The herald counts the coins and leaves without another word.
event.levy.result.refuse: The soldiers collect the fine themselves: you lose {coins} coins.
event.farmhand.title: A lad seeks work
event.farmhand.text: A scrawny lad knocks at your door. For a pallet by the fire and a coin a day, he will work your fields from dawn to dusk.
event.farmhand.result.hire: The lad gets to work. Your crops will grow faster as long as you can pay his daily coin.
event.farmhand.result.decline: The lad walks off down the road, head bowed.
event.fair.title: Fair in the village
event.fair.text: The criers announce three days of fair. Merchants come from all over the shire and pay well.
event.fair.result.go: For three days the market pays half again for everything.
event.fair.result.stay: You carry on with your chores. There will be other fairs.
event.fox.title: A fox prowls the coop
event.fox.text: At dawn you find feathers by the fence and tracks in the mud. A fox has caught the scent of your hens.
event.fox.result.fence: You nail up new boards. The fox will have to look for supper elsewhere.
event.fox.result.risk: The nights pass and the fox doesn't return. Luck was with you this time.
event.fox.result.risk.fail: One morning a hen is missing. Only feathers remain.
event.peddler.title: A peddler on the road
event.peddler.text: A peddler with a mule laden with trinkets stops at your door. He swears that in the city eggs fetch a king's ransom.
event.peddler.result.sellEggs: The peddler takes {amount} eggs and leaves you {coins} coins.
event.peddler.result.decline: The peddler goes on his way, whistling.
